job.title: Soda Stream: DTC & eCommerce Analyst DACH (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Techno-Functional E-Commerce Analyst | SAP Commerce Cloud & API Integrations
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional e-commerce professional with 5+ years of experience analyzing business requirements, designing data flows, and delivering enterprise platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for global brands like Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong background in requirements engineering, process mapping, OCC REST APIs, PIM/ERP/MDM integration, and working closely with international business and technical stakeholders to optimize DTC and e-commerce channel performance.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Soda Stream: DTC & eCommerce Analyst DACH (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: Driving direct-to-consumer and e-commerce channel optimization for global enterprise brands requires a precise blend of commercial understanding and technical execution. Bringing over 5 years of hands-on experience building and supporting large-scale platforms on SAP Commerce Cloud at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am excited to apply my techno-functional expertise to help PepsiCo accelerate its DTC and eCommerce initiatives across the DACH region.

bullets.label: Requirements & Process Mapping
bullets.text: Acted in a key techno-functional role bridging business and IT stakeholders at Rockwell Automation and Shell, gathering requirements, mapping complex e-commerce processes, and authoring functional specifications and user stories.

bullets.label: Platform & Integration Analysis
bullets.text: Designed and analysed robust data flows and integration pipelines between PIM, ERP, MDM, and SAP Commerce platforms, ensuring seamless product catalog and customer data synchronization across global channels.

bullets.label: API & Headless Architecture
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST APIs and headless integration endpoints, enabling smooth third-party channel connections and digital storefront enhancements.

bullets.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
bullets.text: Collaborated daily with international product owners, business teams, and technical developers to support user acceptance testing, resolve production bottlenecks, and deliver continuous platform improvements.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German residence and work permit, I am serving a notice period with a final working day on 15 December 2026 and am available to start from 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my techno-functional background can contribute to PepsiCo's e-commerce success.

tailoring.why_company: PepsiCo's iconic brands and ambitious digital evolution in the DACH e-commerce and DTC space present an inspiring environment for a techno-functional analyst. I am eager to apply my expertise in platform integration, requirements engineering, and cross-functional delivery to help scale SodaStream's digital channels and deliver seamless online customer experiences.
tailoring.motivation_short: Combining 5+ years of SAP Commerce expertise with strong business analysis skills to drive e-commerce and DTC channel growth at PepsiCo.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! With 5+ years of SAP Commerce and techno-functional analysis experience across global enterprise projects, I've applied for the DTC & eCommerce Analyst DACH role at PepsiCo. I'd love to connect and discuss how I can support your digital channel growth.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Soda Stream: DTC & eCommerce Analyst DACH (m/w/d) – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the DTC & eCommerce Analyst DACH position at PepsiCo. With over 5 years of techno-functional experience delivering enterprise e-commerce platforms, requirements engineering, and complex integrations on SAP Commerce Cloud, I am well-equipped to support your digital growth initiatives.

Please find my CV and cover letter attached. I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
